Material\'s `PasswordToggleEndIconDelegate` installs an end-icon click listener that calls `setTransformationMethod()` on *only its own* `EditText`, so the confirmation field never reacted to the visibility toggle.\n\n## Fix\n\nAdded a reusable helper in `Utilities/UIHelper.java` that replaces the end-icon click listener with one that toggles the transformation method on **both** the password field and the linked confirmation field (preserving cursor position):\n\n```java\npublic static void linkPasswordConfirmToToggle(final TextInputLayout passwordLayout, final EditText passwordConfirm) {\n    if (passwordLayout == null) return;\n    passwordLayout.setEndIconOnClickListener(new View.OnClickListener() {\n        @Override public void onClick(View view) {\n            EditText passwordInput = passwordLayout.getEditText();\n            if (passwordInput == null) return;\n            boolean showPassword = isPasswordHidden(passwordInput);\n            setPasswordVisibility(passwordInput, showPassword);\n            setPasswordVisibility(passwordConfirm, showPassword);\n        }\n    });\n}\n```\n\nThe eye icon\'s checked/animated state keeps working, because `TextInputLayout` tracks it through a `TextWatcher` on its own `EditText` (which `setTransformationMethod()` triggers) rather than through the click listener.\n\nWired into all four places that pair a toggle-enabled password field with a plain confirmation field:\n- `Activities/IntroScreenActivity.java` — the reported bug (first-time password/PIN setup)\n- `Preferences/CredentialsPreference.java` — Settings → Authentication\n- `Preferences/PasswordEncryptedPreference.java` — backup password/PIN\n- `Dialogs/PasswordEntryDialog.java` — password update dialog\n\n## Verification (emulator, real run)\n\n1.
